1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said light emitting diodes are mounted directly to said columnar body without intervening substrate elements, and wherein said fins are integrally formed with said columnar body__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and unobstructed by any optical or thermal element__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is positioned to direct light in a non-perpendicular direction relative to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is configured to convert light wavelengths emitted by said diodes__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and mounted directly to side faces of said columnar body without intervening structural elements__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said fins are sized and positioned to occupy substantially all space between adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length-to-width ratio greater than 2:1__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned at substantially the center of each face__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin extends radially outward from a corner junction between two adjacent faces__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and is positioned centrally on said face, with no additional diodes on any face__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected from the group consisting of copper, aluminum alloys, and composite materials with embedded thermal conductors__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __wherein each optic element is individually sized and shaped to correspond to a single diode and the space between adjacent fins__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and is mechanically and electrically isolated from said columnar body by an insulating interface__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes thermal management circuitry for monitoring and regulating temperature of said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and is configured with a refractive index and surface geometry optimized for said perpendicular light direction__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted directly to each side of said body without intervening substrate, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open and unobstructed, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline __and a length-to-width ratio greater than 2:1__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode directly to said body without intervening substrate elements, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __wherein said fins are integrally formed during the extrusion process__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from aluminum alloys having thermal conductivity of at least 180 W/mK__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed as part of the extrusion process and extending from corner edges of the polygonal cross-section__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and polygonal cross-sectional geometry with at least four sides__.
